decisions.reason: As the remaining new single-tube condenser after earlier pruning, it still fits the core portfolio and is worth keeping while the firm learns whether demand justifies a lasting place in the line-up.
This corrosion-repair liner extends the service and retrofit business at low incremental cost, so the option value of staying in the market remains clearly positive.
The customized air-cooler line is closely aligned with the firm's solution-oriented strategy and broad customer base, making withdrawal unlikely unless orders disappoint sharply.
